title: stardust rollout/workspace/manifest.json
description: Hashes and handover state for the coverage a client reads. outputs hashes the three coverage files and workspace/mapping.json when present (what a client reads); inputs hashes what the coverage was built from (the content documents as one summary, the block code read, the judgement). placeholders lists what is still a default. Once a client has taken the project over, the writer refuses to run unless forced; a forced run records handover and, when inputs changed, degraded. Deterministic: unchanged inputs give byte-identical output. Owned by stardust:rollout; strict here because it describes exactly what stardust writes.

formatVersion.description: Manifest format version (semver). Before 1.0.0 a release may still change the shape; from 1.0.0 a minor release only adds fields, clients ignore fields they do not know, and removing or renaming a field is a major release.

inputs.description: What the coverage was built from, keys sorted: content (the content documents, summarised), each block code file read and the judgement, keyed by project-relative path.

outputs.description: The coverage files a client reads, keyed by project-relative path (<out>/coverage/{pages,templates,blocks}.json), and <out>/workspace/mapping.json when present.

placeholders.description: One line per value that is still a default: template names and descriptions, blocks with base type unknown or without purpose, reuse guidance or colour scheme (not judged), pages without a delivered structure.

templateGroups.description: The template count split from coverage/templates.json: archetypes = the distinct page types (each untyped template its own archetype), siblings = the templates beyond the first of each type — cloned siblings the export emits as their own group, so total = archetypes + siblings. No coverage field records a sibling's parent archetype, so the split is by type, not a parent link. Absent from the drift hashes: a re-hash recomputes it, it never counts as drift.

archetypes.description: Distinct page types (plus any untyped template).

siblings.description: Cloned sibling groups beyond one archetype per type (total − archetypes).

selectorQuality.description: Derived from workspace/mapping.json at manifest time (block-origin countsOf; mapping.json is not rewritten). Present only when a readable mapping exists. Absent from the drift hashes: a re-hash recomputes it, it never counts as drift.

instances.description: Delivered block instances in the mapping.

sources.description: How each instance's source selector was found.

textAlignment.description: Located by the text they cover.

position.description: Located by position among anchored neighbours (confidence 0).

encoderCoverage.description: encoderMap / instances, 0 to 1, three decimals (0 when there are no instances).

zeroConfidence.description: Instances at confidence 0 — image-only repeating blocks with no text to anchor, shipped without an encoder map.

zeroConfidenceBlocks.description: The top blocks behind zeroConfidence (the whole count stays in zeroConfidence), most instances first.

byTemplate.description: Per mapping template, most instances first: the instance count and its split across the three selector sources, so a reviewer sees which templates are encoder-backed and which fell back. Optional (older manifests omit it).

encoderCoverage.description: encoderMap / instances for this template, three decimals (0 when it has no instances).

sectionGaps.description: Derived from workspace/mapping.json at manifest time (not a rewrite of it). Present only when a readable mapping exists ([] when none apply). The sections an adopter projecting mapping.json per selector would drop: a section with no source selector (reason no-selector) is not emitted at all; a section that keeps its selector but whose declared blocks are merged away under the per-selector projection (reason blocks-unprojected). Absent from the drift hashes: a re-hash recomputes it, it never counts as drift.

page.description: A page slug the section appears on (the section's first page, else the template id).

reason.description: no-selector = the section has no source selector, so the adopter does not emit it; blocks-unprojected = the section keeps its selector but its blocks are lost to the per-selector projection.

blocks.description: The declared block names dropped with the section.

judgement.description: Derived from workspace/judgement.json at manifest time (not a rewrite). Present only when a readable judgement.json with a toFill[] exists. The judgement's own documentation debt: toFill = the fields it lists in toFill[] that are still empty; byKind splits that by field (name, description, purpose, reuseGuidance, baseType). Distinct from placeholders (unjudged COVERAGE values). Absent from the drift hashes: a re-hash recomputes it, it never counts as drift.

toFill.description: Judgement fields listed in toFill[] that are still empty.

byKind.description: toFill split by field name (e.g. purpose, reuseGuidance, baseType, name, description); only fields with a non-zero count appear.

handover.description: null before handover; set only by a forced run after a client took the project over. Absent while the export is incomplete: captures exist and workspace/mapping.json does not (the writer exits 2) — not ready to hand over.

detectedFrom.description: marker = workspace/handover.json exists; untracked-content = content was tracked and no longer is; manifest = the previous manifest already recorded a handover.

handoverNotes.description: Owner handover actions — sentences for the project owner. Present only when non-empty (e.g. delivered blocks with no judged base type; unknown is not a judged value, the owner names them).

degraded.description: Present only when a forced run read inputs that differ from the previous manifest.

writtenAt.description: The pages.json generatedAt (never the wall clock).

stardustVersion.description: Version that built the export, from rollout.json's _provenance.stardustVersion (inventory.mjs) so it is export-local and a recompute matches; else the STARDUST_VERSION env or the installed plugin manifest; null when none resolves. Never part of the drift comparison.

sha256.description: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.
One hash over the content documents' paths and hashes.

tracked.description: Whether the content documents are tracked by the project repository; null when the project is not its own repository root.
